critical_code_review_comments: /api/geo uses http://ip-api.com (plain HTTP) with a 4s timeout and swallows all exceptions returning empty strings. Failure-open is fine for this UX but note: if ip-api.com is unreachable/rate-limited (45 req/min free tier per source IP), all visitors get empty country_code and enforceGeoBlock silently no-ops. Consider a fallback provider or short in-memory cache keyed by IP.

/api/geo splits X-Forwarded-For and trusts the first IP unconditionally — spoofable by a client sending its own X-Forwarded-For header directly (the ingress may or may not overwrite). For a country-block that's cosmetic (blur) this is acceptable, but worth documenting.

restrictSensitive() still only strips <option> matching /in person/i — regex centralization suggestion still applies.
